assertions.evidence: scripts/summarize-tickets.mjs sends a POST to OPENROUTER_API_URL (default "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions") with model "openai/gpt-4o-mini" and a system prompt "Write exactly one concise paragraph summarizing the support ticket", then reads data.choices[0].message.content as the summary; this is a generative chat completion, not the Decisions API.
